quarterly_data.signal: Company forecast revision (release PDF, 08-10-2026): Sumitomo Metal Mining raised its consolidated forecast for FY2026 (April 1, 2026 - March 31, 2027) from the one announced on May 11, 2026 - net sales JPY 2,065,000 million (previous forecast JPY 1,883,000 million, +9.7%), profit before tax JPY 324,000 million (previous JPY 229,000 million, +41.5%), profit JPY 237,000 million (previous JPY 156,000 million, +51.9%) and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 216,000 million (previous JPY 139,000 million, +55.4%). Stated reason: given the first-quarter results, the company reviewed the production and sales plans of each business, taking into account recent trends in non-ferrous metal prices, exchange rates and other factors, which led to higher projected net sales and profit.
